correctness.rationale: Unique-maximum partition and independence give convolution of strict barrier survival events; exponential memorylessness turns those into two pure exponential factors. value.rationale: It settles a natural full finite-sample order-statistic distribution for an asymmetric walk, provides explicit finite-n moments and a positive sharp TV constant, and distinguishes polynomially slow zero-drift equilibration from exponentially fast nonzero-drift equilibration. Gap separation is an interpretable near-record statistic. Beyond the known symmetric special case, the unequal-rate structural mixture and rate crossover are nontrivial.
